from.name: Summer Camp Registration
from.description: A parent or guardian registers a child for a summer camp week and pays the deposit while signing.

body.p: Camper name: [[text:Parent or Guardian:Camper name]]  Age: [[text:Parent or Guardian:Camper age]]
A deposit of USD 250 is paid with this registration and is credited against the camp fee. It is refundable until 30 days before the camp week.
Emergency contact: [[text:Parent or Guardian:Emergency contact name]]  Phone: [[text:Parent or Guardian:Emergency contact phone]]
Allergies or medical needs: [[text?:Parent or Guardian:Allergies and medical needs]]
[[check:Parent or Guardian:Medical consent]] In an emergency, I authorize camp staff to obtain medical treatment for the camper if I cannot be reached.

name: Summer Camp Registration
summary: A NEW document inline, offered as a PowerForm (a public self-service link, direct signing, up to 300 uses): the parent registers a camper and pays a USD 250 deposit with a payment tab. The payment needs the account's payment gateway.

powerForm.instructions: Fill in the camper's details, sign and pay the deposit.

emailBlurb: Please complete the registration, sign and pay the deposit.
